notablePrerequisites: Animate Dead attached to Body Launderer.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Renegade Rallier, adding {C}{C}.
Renegade Rallier dies, triggering Body Launderer's first ability, causing it to connive.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Body Launderer, adding {C}{C}.
Body Launderer dies, triggering its second ability, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Renegade Rallier enters the battlefield, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Animate Dead enters the battlefield, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
Repeat.
